summary: Aligos Therapeutics filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026, disclosing a License Agreement with Xiamen Amoytop Biotech Co., Ltd. Aligos grants an exclusive license for pevifoscorvir sodium to treat Hepatitis B/D in mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau. Amoytop must pay a $25M upfront cash payment plus up to $420M in milestones and high single-digit royalties on net sales. Effectiveness is conditioned on Amoytop's shareholder approval within 45 days. Aligos retains rights to manufacture for use outside the Territory and improvements revert to Aligos. This is a licensing deal, not a special situation M&A.
